values.calibration_note: 28 of 30 packs put the catalyst to beat at 50% of the best possible, within 2 points, at their anchor temperature. Gas-engine oxidation catalyst (CO, HCHO, CH4, NO) sits at 100% at 427 °C; High-temperature SCR of NOx with NH3 sits at 88% at 566 °C. These two packs came before the design app: their illustrative rates follow a conventional catalyst across the whole operating window, and their reference temperature anchors the rate constants in place of a light-off. The ranking within each reaction stays the same; their curves sit hotter or cooler accordingly.
